segments.an5.107:1.1: “Pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa.
segments.an5.107:2.2: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sīlasampanno hoti, samādhisampanno hoti, paññāsampanno hoti, vimuttisampanno hoti, vimuttiñāṇadassanasampanno hoti.
segments.an5.107:3.1: “Imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā”ti.

lines: 107-108. Sattame sīlasamādhipaññā missikā kathitā, vimutti arahattaphalaṃ, vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ paccavekkhaṇañāṇaṃ lokiyameva.
Paccavekkhaṇañāṇaṃ panettha asekhassa pavattattā asekhanti vuttaṃ.
106-110. Chaṭṭhe adhisīleti nimittatthe bhummaṃ, sīlanimittaṃ na upavadati na nindatīti attho.
Attani kamme ca anu anu pekkhati sīlenāti attānupekkhī.
